text:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — Biotex renewal running into two quick blocks: AP wants vendor code on PO and their procurement asks for Net15 instead of our Net30. They need a signed agreement to release seats.
Ethan (Sales): Pri from Biotex said they can update PO within hours if we accept Net15 for first invoice only.
Pri (Biotex): Sorry for the scramble — our new AP system enforces Net15 on new vendors. We can attach vendor code BTX-44 and include a note mapping to Biotex Corp.
Clara (Finance): Net15 is aggressive. We can accept Net15 for the initial invoice if they add the vendor code and include a PDF confirmation from CFO mapping BTX-44 -> Biotex Corp (VAT ID required). We'll mark as conditional and require amendment to formalize.
Omar (Legal): Agreed. Email confirmation from CFO is acceptable for now. We'll prepare a minimal amendment template: short clause to apply Net15 for invoice date 2026-04-02 and revert terms afterward unless otherwise agreed.
Maya (CS): Pri, can you upload the PO and get CFO confirmation in this thread? Need the PO number to appear exactly as PO-BTX-2026-004 in invoice field.
Pri (Biotex): Uploaded PO: https://files.biotex.example/PO-BTX-2026-004.pdf. CFO reply: "We confirm BTX-44 maps to Biotex Corp (VAT: IE987654321) and agree to Net15 for the initial invoice dated 2026-04-02." Attached signed note.
DocuSign Bot: Created envelope env-btx-4401 status=sent
Clara (Finance): Received CFO note and PO. I'll queue the invoice but flag for a follow-up amendment.
Ethan (Sales): Quick ops note: update CRM renewal record with vendor code and CFO confirmation so renewals team sees this for next cycle.
Maya (CS): Updated envelope with PO-BTX-2026-004 in invoice section and resent. Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/env-btx-4401
DocuSign Bot: Envelope env-btx-4401 status=completed
Clara (Finance): Invoice created referencing PO-BTX-2026-004, term Net15, due 2026-04-17.
Omar (Legal): I'll push the amendment template to Pri tomorrow; please ask them to sign within 10 business days.
Maya (CS): Closing — renewal executed, delay ~36 hours around PO/vendor-code capture. Action items: legal to send amendment, finance to confirm amendment once signed, sales to add vendor code to renewal playbook. :white_check_mark:
Pri (Biotex): Thanks team — appreciate the fast help.
